notes.name: Animagine XL 4.0
notes.what: Danbooru-tag anime generation on an SDXL base.
notes.special: Speaks TAGS, not prose - the dialect law. Crossing a character card between this and a prose engine silently deletes the character.

notes.name: FLUX.1 Fill + OneReward
notes.what: Inpainting and outpainting.
notes.special: How master-frame outpainting widens a shot without redrawing the subject.

notes.name: FLUX.2 [dev]
notes.what: Text-to-image and multi-reference editing on an improved diffusion transformer, native up to 4 megapixels.
notes.special: The current benchmark for open-weight image quality, and the leader on prompt fidelity. Spells only QUOTED strings - our typography engine.

notes.name: Qwen-Image 2512
notes.what: Text-to-image with the strongest in-image text rendering of the open models.
notes.special: Leads multilingual text-to-image. Our default image engine - PROSE, and it cannot be prompted off photography at any cfg.

notes.name: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511
notes.what: Instruction editing: change one thing and keep everything else.
notes.special: Two-image fusion - compose separately generated people into one photo. Capability 20.

notes.name: Z-Image Turbo
notes.what: Small, very fast text-to-image - about a second an image.
notes.special: Throughput-per-dollar leader. The ideation model: twenty options in the time FLUX.2 takes for one. Capability 33.

notes.name: HunyuanVideo 1.5
notes.what: Text-to-video and image-to-video, plus a 1080p super-resolution stage.
notes.special: Strongest scene coherence over longer clips and the most realistic human motion. INSTALLED AND UNTESTED here - the largest unopened box in the library.

notes.name: LTX-2.3
notes.what: Image-to-video with a synchronised audio track in the same forward pass.
notes.special: Speed, and a nearly flat cost curve in clip length. The only engine here that generates picture and sound together. Our default.

notes.name: LTX-2.5
notes.what: Native MULTI-SHOT video: several connected shots with real cuts in one generation.
notes.special: A cut is where identity normally breaks. Measured here against 2.3 on the same subject: drift -0.004 against 0.141. Capability 51.

notes.name: Wan 2.1 VACE 14B
notes.what: Video editing: restyle, inpaint or extend footage that already exists.
notes.special: The only real answer here to shot-to-shot look matching. Installed, not built.

notes.name: Wan 2.2
notes.what: Image-to-video, the photorealism leader among open models.
notes.special: Best open model for HUMAN subjects - faces, skin and hair hold where others smear. Roughly 8x slower than LTX, which is why LTX carries the slate.

notes.name: ACE-Step v1 3.5B
notes.what: Text-to-music from tag prompts, with bpm and key control.
notes.special: Our 32 music cues. The FULL model at cfg 5 - the v1.5 turbo at cfg 1.0 ignores the prompt entirely, measured here the hard way.

notes.name: CosyVoice2-0.5B
notes.what: Streaming-capable zero-shot TTS.
notes.special: Small and fast enough to stream. NOT INSTALLED.

notes.name: F5-TTS
notes.what: Flow-matching text-to-speech.
notes.special: Noticeably more natural prosody than XTTS v2 on long inputs. NOT INSTALLED - the strongest candidate for narration if Higgs disappoints.

notes.name: Fish Speech V1.5
notes.what: Multilingual zero-shot voice cloning.
notes.special: Named with IndexTTS-2 and CosyVoice2 as the 2026 front rank. NOT INSTALLED.

notes.name: Higgs Audio v3
notes.node_managed: managed by the TTS-Audio-Suite node, no checkpoint in models/ - our 17 voice packs run on it
notes.what: Voice cloning from a reference clip.
notes.special: What our 17 usable voice packs run on. Node-managed, so no file in models/.

notes.name: IndexTTS-2
notes.node_managed: managed by the TTS-Audio-Suite node, no checkpoint in models/ - runs every time a film speaks
notes.what: Zero-shot voice cloning with independent timbre and emotion control, and precise duration control.
notes.special: Beats other zero-shot TTS on word error rate, speaker similarity AND emotional fidelity. The duration control is the dubbing feature - a line can be made to fit a shot. Runs via TTS-Audio-Suite, no checkpoint of its own in models/.

notes.name: Stable Audio 3 Medium
notes.what: Text-to-audio for sound effects and short samples.
notes.special: Our 35 sound effects. One sound per bed at cfg 7 / 100 steps; the defaults produce mush.

notes.name: Hunyuan3D 2.1
notes.what: Image to textured 3D mesh.
notes.special: The 3D-print route: shape plus PBR texture rather than shape alone.

notes.name: TripoSplat
notes.what: Image to 3D gaussian splat.
notes.special: Splats rather than meshes - better for viewing, not printable. Installed, untested.

notes.name: Qwen2.5-VL 7B
notes.what: Vision-language model: describe an image, answer questions about it.
notes.special: Our frame_check instrument - it is what looks at a render and says whether the nouns we asked for are actually in it.

notes.name: SAM 3.1
notes.what: Segment anything - masks from a point, a box or a prompt.
notes.special: The masking layer under removal and compositing.

notes.name: RealESRGAN x4plus
notes.what: Classic 4x upscaler.
notes.special: 1664x928 to 6656x3712 in 4.5s. Fast and predictable; SeedVR2 is the quality option when it is finally tested.

notes.name: SeedVR2 3B
notes.what: Diffusion video and image restoration.
notes.special: Restoration, not interpolation - it reconstructs detail instead of smoothing it. Installed, untested.
